description: Follows Yang Zhi’s failed commission, encounter with Niu Er, and service to Liang Zhongshu, then Chao Gai’s coalition and the Birthday Gifts episode. Explores patronage, official gift exchange, labor and trust, Song Jiang’s intervention, and the violent succession from Wang Lun to Chao Gai at Liangshan.
